Hannah (CSM): heads-up — AegisLabs dropped ~70% API activity overnight after their VP of ML left. Procurement mentioned a partner demo touting "seamless ETL integration" and lower list price. Renewal in 28 days. need a quick triage & a retention play. :eyes:
Jon (CS Ops): on it. first check: keys/allowlist or hit by our edge incident? any billing or quota flags?
Hannah (CSM): console shows last activity ~40h ago, no config changes. champion was running inference pipelines. new PM hasn't replied to enablement invites.
ops-bot: [auto] 2025-06-22T02:12:14Z - edge: brief spike us-west-1 02:09-02:15 UTC - ~1.05k requests affected.
Marta (Solutions Eng): likely causes: token rotation, IP egress block, or they flipped to a cheaper model and hit tenant throttles. Quick test they can run from their infra: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $AEGIS_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
``` 401/403 -> token issue; 429 -> throttling; 5xx -> edge.
Jon (CS Ops): pulled tenant logs for aegis-labs: cluster of 403s at 02:08 UTC then retries with some 429s during the edge spike. looks like key rejected then burst retries. no billing alerts.
Rex (AE): procurement already has a CompetitorDemo Tues. they flagged "integration with our data pipeline" and "lower ops headcount". If it's config we can fix quickly. propose: 1) 7-day Dedicated extension 2) 30m triage w/SE 3) benchmark doc (p50/p95, token cost, ops delta).
Marta (Solutions Eng): i'll prep a one-pager + a tiny harness they can run that reports status and p95. snippet: ```python
import requests, time
H={'Authorization': 'Bearer $AEGIS_TOKEN'}
lat=[]
for _ in range(15):
  t0=time.time(); requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers=H, json={'model':'rwd-prod','input':'ping'}); lat.append((time.time()-t0)*1000)
print(sorted(lat)[int(0.95*len(lat))])
```
Jon (CS Ops): action items: @Marta one-pager + harness (ETA: today EOD), i'll create a short-lived support token and flag billing to pause auto-invoice if we extend. also will verify there are no lingering throttles on their tenant.
Hannah (CSM): i'll message their PM & procurement now and offer earliest triage slot. if no reply by EOD i'll escalate to our exec sponsor.
Rex (AE): i'll draft the benchmark summary and include finance contact. no pricing promises.
Marta (Solutions Eng): initial checklist posted: 1) validate token (401/403) 2) confirm IP allowlist / VPN egress 3) run health & generate checks (snippets above) 4) if 429 -> check tenant rate limits & request transient bump 5) enable KV cache & batching flags on trial 6) collect request IDs & attach logs for support
Jon (CS Ops): noted. also: if they ask for integration examples, we can show our ETL connector patterns and a short case study.
Hannah (CSM): thanks all. target: triage within 48h, run benchmark within 72h, then propose a 6-month reserved pilot if numbers look good. will update thread after procurement reply. :white_check_mark:
